summary: Starwood Real Estate Income Trust, Inc. filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 on August 31, 2026, declaring its regular monthly distributions for each class of common stock. Gross distribution is $0.0770 per share across Class I, D, T, and S, with stockholder servicing fees of $0.0041 for Class D and $0.0141 for Classes T and S, yielding net distributions of $0.0770, $0.0729, $0.0629, and $0.0629 respectively. Record date is August 31, 2026, payable on or about September 3, 2026, in cash or via the distribution reinvestment plan. No special-situation or deal terms disclosed.
